title: Session tab lobby: seat cards, held seat, Add player, Keep in session
covers: SessionLobby seat grid, SeatEditor, Add player tile, tab status dot
context: The lobby of a session tab looks like a game lobby: a seat card for each player with the game art, a dashed held seat for a saved direct player who has not joined, and an Add player tile. The selected seat opens its editor under the grid. A player added here is for this run only until Keep in session. The tab carries a status dot.
changed: views/SessionLobby: SeatsPane, OwnSeat, SeatEditor, ChangesChip, LobbyHeader
Tessera SeatCard and SeatGrid; Tessera tab status dot

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: game
setup.text: A Link to the Past installed: Library, Games, tab Built-in, press Add on its card.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: session
setup.text: Make it in the test: Seat check, Where Local, Allow direct connections on, players Host1 and Host2 (A Link to the Past) and a third player Guest with the Direct switch on and no game.

steps: Make the session Seat check as in the setup line, press Save and run. A tab Seat check opens. Its dot and the tooltip of the dot read Lobby.
Read the stage header: the name, the status Lobby, Where, the session code with a copy button, and the buttons Edit setup, Close lobby and Run. Under it the heading reads Players with the count 3.

In the seat grid Host1 and Host2 are filled cards with the game art, Slot 1 and Slot 2, the tag Saved and the game. The seat of Guest is dashed and reads Waiting for Guest to connect. The last tile is Add player.

Press the card of Hos It is selected and an editor opens under the grid titled Slot 1 with Name, Game, Preset, Overrides Change the pres The header gets a tag n changes from s Hover it: it lists Press Done.
Press the tile Add player. A new card appears with the tag Added here and becomes the selected seat. Give it a game. The count in the heading goes up.
On the Added here card press Keep in session. The tag turns to Saved. Open Sessions and pick Seat check: the player is in its Players grid. Go back to the tab.
Use Duplicate on a card and then Remove on the copy. Each card has Remove and Duplicate. A held seat has only Edit.
Right-click the tab. The menu offers Close and Close other tabs. Press Close: the tab closes with no question, because nobody joined.
pass: Saved players show as filled cards, a direct player who has not joined shows as a dashed held seat, and the last tile is Add player.
The selected seat opens its editor under the grid. Changes show as n changes from saved in the header.
Added here players are for this run only until Keep in session turns them into saved players.
The tab has a status dot with the label Lobby, and Close works from its menu.
fail: The held seat is a filled card, or the Add player tile is missing.
The editor opens somewhere else than under the grid, or the header never shows the changes.
Keep in session does not save the player into the session.
notes: A player added in the lobby and not kept is lost when the tab closes. Only Keep in session writes it to the saved session.
Joining players and approval are in the next test. The room is in the test Live room.
